body:
Snapping at `_animation_key_editor_seek()` seems to break the interaction with snap features altogether.

Well, the main issue is that the system is too intertwined with the UI and signals. The logic sets the UI, then UI emit signals which also set the state, then the state triggers UI updates, and so on. The `updating` flag seems to be used in many places to fix similar issues for the same reasons, so I followed the pattern.

A general solution is probably to refactor all state logic in `AnimationPlayerEditor` using `set_block_signals()`, like `AnimationTrackEditor` does. But it's outside of this PR context.

Hey @ydeltastar , can you have a look at my PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118031 ?
It reworks the way the timeline is updated:
Previous: frame->set_value() causes signal - signal then calls back to animation editor indirectly, frame is used to clamp min and max values
Now: animation editor calls itself directly and pushes to frame->value, still using min max facilities of frame

I remember removing an updating flag guard in "_animation_key_editor_seek" that looked just like yours because the new codepath didn't need this around the corner updating anymore.

I was unable to reproduce your issue on my build but I then also tried to reproduce it on the 4.7.dev commit you mentioned in the issue (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/f9a8302c8395db323fdeebcb1d8024b9fc661999), release and debug builds and I can not get it to happen. The shortcut always works more me. That is why I'd be nice if you can verify it.

> I was unable to reproduce your issue on my build but I then also tried to reproduce it on the 4.7.dev commit you mentioned in the issue ([f9a8302](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/f9a8302c8395db323fdeebcb1d8024b9fc661999)), release and debug builds and I can not get it to happen.

You have to disable "Apply snapping to timeline cursor" to reproduce the issue. Also, when cursor snapping is enabled but the snapping step is too small, like 0.002, both go to the previous and next keyframe need to be pressed twice, depending on the keyframe's time.

I tested the artifact of your PR and `Go to Previous Keyframe` doesn't work at all after the first time if snapping is disabled.

I didn't notice it required a specific configuration to trigger the issue. I updated the issue and added a reproduction example.
